rationale: The two parsers are essentially identical, with the same digit switch and overflow check. The deciding difference is error classification. B defines sentinel errors (errSyntax, errRange) and has HandleErrors use errors.Is, which is the idiomatic, robust way to distinguish errors in Go. A builds ad-hoc errors and classifies them by searching the message text for 'range', which is brittle. A's messages are more informative (they name the bad character), and its math.MaxInt64 is preferable to B's hand-written constant, but B's error design is the more important quality.
